entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The present application is filed by the Applicant for enlarging the Applicant on Furlough Leave.
2. Heard learned APP Mr. Bhargav Pandya for the Respondent - State.
Learned APP waives service of Rule on behalf of the Respondent State.
3. From the record it appears that the Applicant had preferred Application for Furlough Leave before the Jail Authorities which was dismissed on 12.3.2024.

The reason for dismissal of the Application is to the effect that the Applicant is sentenced for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(N) of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3(1)W) and 3(2)5 of the Atrocity Act and Section 6 of the POCSO Act and is imposed sentence of 20 Years each in both the offences.

Moreover, it is apprehended that since the Applicant and the first informant are residing in the same area and there is apprehension of breach of peace if the Applicant is ordered to be enlarged on NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/4703/2024 ORDER DATED: 15/04/2024 undefined Furlough Dharmesh @ Kano Kalubhai Rathod vs State Of Gujarat on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/47203486/
1 Leave.
4.

entities.text: Furlough Dharmesh @ Kano Kalubhai Rathod vs State Of Gujarat
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Having regard to the aforesaid aspect, the Application deserves consideration.

The Applicant - DHARMESH @ KANO KALUBHAI RATHOD is ordered to be released on Furlough for a period of 14 days from the date of actual release, upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs. 5,000/- (Rupees Five Thousand only) with a surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the jail authority, and on a further condition that the Applicant shall surrender to the Jail authorities on expiry of the Furlough period.
5. The application is allowed in the aforesaid terms.
